# CONTEXT.md — .github/scripts/

The audits and tests of `DESIGN.md` Section 7, one script per row, in the syntek-base house shape:
a header saying why the check exists (the failure it prevents), numbered checks, what it CANNOT
check, a `--self-test` that proves each check fires on its own mutation with exactly one finding,
and exit codes 0 (clean), 1 (findings, or a self-test that no longer separates) and 2 (could not
run). Check numbers are stable identifiers: append, never renumber.

Every audit runs with `SYNTEK_DATA_ROOT` unset (DESIGN.md D50): `_common.sh` unsets it when a
script sources it, and `run-all.sh` starts every step under `env -u SYNTEK_DATA_ROOT`; CI never
sets it, every audit unsets it through `_common.sh`, and CI's three Python self-tests run under
`env -u SYNTEK_DATA_ROOT`. A case that needs a data root makes a temporary one holding its own
`.syntek-data-root` marker and passes it to that one command.

Nothing here is rendered, and nothing here writes under `template/`.

## What's here

Grouped by what each script reads:

- **The template source** (`copier.yml`, `template/`, the root settings and development files):
  `check-template-tokens.sh`, `gen-mode-excludes.sh`, `docs-pairing.sh`, `line-cap.sh`,
  `scrub.sh`, `dev-isolation.sh`, `shipped-seeds.sh`, `skill-conformance.sh`,
  `family-shared.sh`.
- **The renders** that `generate-all.sh` produces, read by `shipped-variants.sh`,
  `byte-identity.sh`, `doc-references.sh`, `tooling-smoke.sh`, and `docs-pairing.sh`,
  `shipped-seeds.sh`, `skill-conformance.sh` again: thirty-six trees from thirty-eight profiles.
  - Theology, fiction and business × defaults (the `external` store, which a fresh copy takes),
    all-on, minimal, adoption and `repo`, plus fiction-conlang. Business all-on keeps its files
    in the repository with Google Drive, so `.github/` ships; the theology and fiction `repo`
    renders sit in folders named `con` and `Книга`, names a slug refuses but `repo` never reads.
  - The store and the provider (D50, D53): business Google Drive under `external`, and at
    `repo` as the twin of business `repo` (`business-repo-gd`: the answers differ only in
    `DATA_PROVIDER`, so byte-identity check 3 judges the Drive gate on real renders); one render
    for each other `DATA_PROVIDER` value (theology `onedrive` and `nas`, fiction `dropbox`,
    business `other-cloud`); two Drive traps that must ship no `.github/` (theology by
    `--data`, fiction by a scratch settings file); a copy beside a sibling answers file from
    before the data root; an `external` business render whose `DATA_AREA` holds a space and
    whose documents kind Copier single-quotes (`business-quoted-area`, so tooling-smoke check
    49 reads Copier's own quoting); and a 95-character folder name.
  - Nine for the other coding agents: business Claude-only; one per OpenCode provider (`named`,
    `llama-cpp`, `ollama`, `vllm`, `lmstudio`, `openai-compatible`; `user` is every defaults
    render); and Trap 2, hidden answers given by `--data` and by a scratch settings file, the
    bad data-root answers under `repo` among them.
  - Two more profiles, a folder name with no ASCII letter or digit and one named `con`, must be
    refused on `DATA_SLUG` (check 5) and leave no tree.
- **Their own scratch projects**: `update-test.sh`, `adopt-test.sh`, `coexist-test.sh`. Their
  self-tests run the whole flow against the fixture template in `_common.sh`, so they prove the
  harness even while the real template is incomplete (`update-test.sh` checks 60–85 need the
  real template, so its self-test judges synthesised trees and logs for them). `update-test.sh`
  also upgrades a business project and each book project from the `v0.1.0` tag to the working
  tree tagged with `VERSION`, or with the newer release its newest `_migrations` entry names
  (checks 13–23), copies at `v0.3.0` for the update that first asks `AGENT_CLIENTS`
  (checks 31–34), and copies at `v0.4.0` and `v0.3.0` for the data root, the provider and the
  MCP servers (checks 60–85), with a later patch tagged on a side branch of its scratch clone,
  so the repository must carry its tags, `v0.4.0` included (CI checks out with `fetch-depth: 0`);
  its self-test gives the fixture two tagged releases of its own and runs the real
  `migrations/v0.2.0-business-families.sh` and `migrations/v0.2.0-project-settings.sh`.
- **`_common.sh`** is the single reader of `copier.yml` (list items, registered keys, gated paths,
  gate negation) and the single transcription of `DESIGN.md` (the skill catalogue, every gated
  path, the seeds, the examples, the spine set, and the business families with their
  `fam-<family>` gates). **It changes in the same commit as `DESIGN.md`.** It also holds the
  D54 MCP constants (the shared `.mcp.json` bytes, the pins, the tool list, the blank keys, the
  asks and the deny) and the D50 data-root constants (the guard command, the marker, the map, the
  resolver and the ignore files), and `SA_PYTHON_MIN`, the one Python minimum of the audits, read
  by every check that names it, with `SA_UVX_COPIER`, the house form of a shown Copier command.
  When a script sources it, it unsets `SYNTEK_DATA_ROOT`, hides the machine's global and system
  git configuration (the CI runner's too), sets `UV_PYTHON` to `python3` where it is unset, and
  refuses to run, exit 2 with one message, where `python3` or `UV_PYTHON` is older than
  `SA_PYTHON_MIN`: the project's tools and the update script refuse that Python by design, so
  every finding would be the interpreter's. Moving the minimum is one change here, one in CI's
  `setup-python` steps and `UV_PYTHON`, and each tool's own `PYTHON_MIN`.

## The spine set, as the audits compute it

`DESIGN.md` Section 2 allows variant tokens and conditional blocks only in the spine set. The
audits compute it from `DESIGN.md` and `copier.yml` together: the root spine; every
`_skip_if_exists` seed; every seed-once example; and every index file — a `CONTEXT.md` or
`CLAUDE.md` whose folder holds a gated descendant. An index file's gates must be shipping gates:
`DESIGN.md` Section 3.5's, or the negation of a templated `_exclude` line.

## Cross-references

- `DESIGN.md` Section 7 — the audit list; Sections 2–5 — the contract the audits check.
- `copier.yml` — read by most scripts; written only by `gen-mode-excludes.sh`, between its markers.
- `.github/workflows/audit-template.yml` — runs these scripts in CI.
- `adopt/theology.sh` — run by `adopt-test.sh` before the adoption copy, when present.
